Gary Eats! — Sidestep Integration

Self-contained asset installer. Adds left/right running sidesteps and shortens the celebration to 0.45 seconds. The current game stays live until you approve the test.

Installation plan
  1. Scan the live engine and check exact patch locations.
  2. Stage two transparent PNG sheets, a separate engine, and a test page.
  3. Play the test on your iPhone. Check both directions, pickups, crashes, restart, and cinematic opening.
  4. Switch the live page to the tested engine when satisfied. Roll back using this installer if needed.
The original game.js, current game-intro-test.js, food data, shop settings and studio are never overwritten. All writes use GitHub's per-file SHA checks and refuse unexpected existing test files.
1 — Verify
2 — Stage test
Test URL: gary-sidestep-test.html
3 — Approve or roll back
